caption: The drawing depicts a single light beige or pale cream dress rendered in detailed shading. The dress has a high waistline, typical of the early 19th century empire style, with short, puffed sleeves that are gathered and decorated with a light border at the hem. The neckline is square and trimmed with a delicate border. The main body of the dress is long, flowing, and subtly patterned with small, repeating marks or dots. A sheer, slightly darker overlay or train drapes from the waist, extending along the right side and down to the floor. The hem of the dress is adorned with a band featuring a scalloped trim and small tassel-like ornaments, along with an additional gathered ruffled edge at the very bottom. The background is plain with a light beige color, and there are a few small brown specks visible on the paper.
title: Empire Wedding Dress
